sloka: एतदाख्याय रामाय महर्षिः कुम्भसम्भवः ।अस्यामेवापरं वाक्यं कथायामुपचक्रमे ।। ७.८०.१ ॥
transliteration: etadākhyāya rāmāya maharṣiḥ kumbhasambhavaḥ ।asyāmevāparaṁ vākyaṁ kathāyāmupacakrame ।। 7.80.1 ॥

translations.english: Having narrated this to Rama, the great sage Agastya then began another part of the same story.
